questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] Which sense is most closely linked to memory?
A. Sight B. Touch C. Smell
Answer: C. This is possibly because the olfactory bulb, which processes scents, has direct connections to areas of the brain strongly linked to emotion and memory, such as the amygdala and hippocampus.
questions.en: Which sense is most closely linked to memory, because its brain pathways connect directly to the amygdala and hippocampus?
questions.de: Welcher Sinn ist am engsten mit dem Gedächtnis verknüpft, weil seine Nervenbahnen direkt mit Amygdala und Hippocampus verbunden sind?

timeline.labelEn: Proust's “Swann's Way”, whose madeleine scene gave smell-triggered recall the name “Proust phenomenon”
timeline.labelDe: Prousts „In Swanns Welt“, dessen Madeleine-Szene der durch Geruch ausgelösten Erinnerung den Namen „Proust-Effekt“ gab

questions.notes: 'Most closely linked' is the popular framing; the source describes the olfactory pathways' direct links to the amygdala and hippocampus and the Proust phenomenon. Swann's Way (1913) date from the In Search of Lost Time article.

questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Inventions] What is the primary engineering application of the Kalman filter?
A. Filtering out particles in a solution
B. Filtering out useful signals in data
C. Filtering out serum from blood
Answer: B. The Kalman filter is an algorithm widely used in spacecraft navigation, robotics, and self-driving cars to produce accurate estimates from noisy measurements.
questions.en: Which algorithm, widely used in spacecraft navigation, robotics and self-driving cars, produces accurate estimates of a system's state from noisy measurements?
questions.de: Welcher Algorithmus, der in der Raumfahrtnavigation, Robotik und bei selbstfahrenden Autos weit verbreitet ist, liefert aus verrauschten Messungen genaue Schätzungen des Zustands eines Systems?

timeline.labelEn: Rudolf Kálmán publishes “A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems”, introducing the Kalman filter
timeline.labelDe: Rudolf Kálmán veröffentlicht „A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems“ und stellt den Kalman-Filter vor

questions.notes: Asked the other way round (the explanation names the uses). Thiele and Swerling had developed similar methods earlier; the filter was used in the Apollo navigation computer.
